name: piece-select
prompt: Short soft wooden peg click, a fingertip tapping a small hollow wood block once, dry and close.

name: place-thunk
prompt: Solid wooden block set firmly onto a timber board, single low knock with a brief warm decay.

name: place-heavy
prompt: Heavy timber plank dropped onto a wooden surface, deep resonant thump with a short rattle.

name: invalid-buzz
prompt: Dull rejected wooden clunk followed by a short raspy rattle, clearly negative feedback, not harsh.

name: line-clear
prompt: Single bright wooden xylophone bar strike with a clean ringing sustain, cheerful and light.

name: clear-double
prompt: Two rising wooden xylophone strikes in quick succession, bright and rewarding.

name: clear-triple
prompt: Three ascending wooden marimba notes in a sparkling cascade, lively celebration.

name: combo-rise
prompt: Quick rising flourish on tuned wooden percussion blocks, energetic upward climb.

name: combo-high
prompt: Fast ascending run across tuned wooden blocks ending on a high sparkling note, triumphant.

name: undo-swipe
prompt: Soft wooden piece sliding backward across a board, gentle short scrape with a muted finish.

name: pause-tick
prompt: Single muted woodblock tick, quiet neutral UI cue, very short decay.

name: game-over
prompt: Two low descending wooden tones, a somber hollow knock followed by a deeper soft thud.

name: win-fanfare
prompt: Short triumphant wooden marimba fanfare, four bright ascending notes resolving on a warm final chord.
